info.title: Open Food Facts
info.description: Look up product data (name, brand, quantity, image) by barcode from the Open Food Facts public database. No API key required.

get.description: Looks up a product by its EAN/UPC barcode and returns its name, brand, quantity, and image URL.

parameters.name: barcode
parameters.description: The product's EAN-13 or UPC-A barcode.

get.description: Proxies the bytes of an image URL (as returned by GetProductByBarcode) through the connector's own server-side code, for callers that can't load the external URL directly.

parameters.name: imageUrl
parameters.description: The image URL returned by GetProductByBarcode.

ean.description: The barcode that was looked up.

quantity.description: The product's package quantity, e.g. '750g' or '1L'. Free text, not a number - Open Food Facts does not normalize units.

imageUrl.description: URL of the product's front-of-pack image.
